1. Why aluminium corrodes in general: the document says aluminium foils are reactive and easily corroded during separation, which contaminates the active materials and complicates separation.

runs.text: The corroded aluminium then contaminates the NMC particles by forming Al(OH)3 precipitates on the cathode surfaces.

runs.text: 3. In the EG process: the aluminium foil was fully recovered with shiny surfaces, which the authors take to mean no corrosion occurred.
The XRD pattern of the recovered foil was attributed to aluminium alone, indicating the process does not corrode aluminium.

runs.text: 4. Removal of corrosion product: the document describes no corrosion product in the EG process, so it describes no step for removing such a product. The only cleaning step it describes is rinsing the delaminated cathode with alcohol to remove EG residues. That step concerns the cathode, not the foil.

rendered:
The premise does not match the document: it does not report that the EG process corroded the aluminium foil. It reports that the foil came out without corrosion. The corrosion discussion is about aluminium in general and about water as an alternative solvent.

1. Why aluminium corrodes in general: the document says aluminium foils are reactive and easily corroded during separation, which contaminates the active materials and complicates separation. [1]

2. Why water was rejected: lithium leaching from the NMC cathode makes the water solution basic, and that corrodes the foil. [2] The corroded aluminium then contaminates the NMC particles by forming Al(OH)3 precipitates on the cathode surfaces.[3][4] 

3. In the EG process: the aluminium foil was fully recovered with shiny surfaces, which the authors take to mean no corrosion occurred. [5] The XRD pattern of the recovered foil was attributed to aluminium alone, indicating the process does not corrode aluminium.[6] 

4. Removal of corrosion product: the document describes no corrosion product in the EG process, so it describes no step for removing such a product. The only cleaning step it describes is rinsing the delaminated cathode with alcohol to remove EG residues. That step concerns the cathode, not the foil. [7]
